interpretation: Present-day fault-bounded structural hypothesis. Faults block the interpolation operator; neither event slip nor invented cumulative throw is applied. Surface traces, reported dips, extrapolation priors and regional chords are distinguished in faults.json. Georeferenced interpreted section lithology/contact picks are fitted; these are not independent validation. Borehole logs are not fitted.

fault_conditioning.method: screened graph Laplace interpolation, zero conductance on finite fault crossings, Dirichlet present-day source labels, clipped GemPy potentials as weak priors

substrate.method: Separate substrate on the finite-fault graph: covered ground is unobserved, one-hot older outcrops and interpreted section constraints, positive normalized weak GemPy priors, ordered older packages, then surficial-cover overlay.
substrate.distance_basis: Matched native unit outcrops and interpreted section constraints; unrelated units do not license a label

status_codes.0: outside domain or no constraint in connected fault block
status_codes.2: within range but competing or weak evidence

limitations: Transfer ranges and score thresholds are modeling assumptions, not calibrated confidence.
A covered location has no direct substrate observation. No boreholes have been added.
No crossing a closed fault edge; paths around finite fault tips remain possible.

surficial_cover.kind: finite surficial-cover thickness prior, not measured basal geometry
surficial_cover.top_cell_exception: Original map label fixed; the top cell can represent unresolved thin cover. Grid thickness is not a field measurement.

H2_or.note: 50m discretization; not a measured or sub-grid thickness

H_sad.note: 50m discretization; not a measured or sub-grid thickness

Q31_std.note: 50m discretization; not a measured or sub-grid thickness

Q32-33_std.note: 50m discretization; not a measured or sub-grid thickness

marine_structure.domain: land plus surrounding sea down to -3000m; offshore computational ceiling 0m, seabed not measured
marine_structure.correlation: Acoustic basin/basement boundary is a structural constraint, not a unique granite/facies code. In this model it constrains the pre-Cenozoic assemblage (pre-Izumi + Izumi) versus younger cover; that correlation is explicitly a hypothesis.
marine_structure.land_lithology_domain: separate -500m computational cap; deep marine acoustic boundary does not justify deeper land lithology
